candidate.title: Added Platform-specific configurations for Helm installs
candidate.text: Added Platform-specific configurations for Helm installs. Example: `helm install istio-cni --set profile=ambient --set global.platform=k3s` `helm install istiod --set profile=ambient --set global.platform=k3s` For list of currently-supported platform overrides, see `manifests/charts/platform-xxx.yaml` files. Removed Openshift profile variants, replaced with `global.platform` overrides. Example: `helm install istio-cni --set profile=ambient-openshift` is now `helm install istio-cni --set profile=ambient --set global.platform=openshift`

evidence.excerpt:
- |
    **Added** Platform-specific configurations for Helm installs. Example:
      `helm install istio-cni --set profile=ambient --set global.platform=k3s`
      `helm install istiod --set profile=ambient --set global.platform=k3s`

      For list of currently-supported platform overrides, see `manifests/charts/platform-xxx.yaml` files.

    **Removed** Openshift profile variants, replaced with `global.platform` overrides. Example:
      `helm install istio-cni --set profile=ambient-openshift` is now
      `helm install istio-cni --set profile=ambient --set global.platform=openshift`
